definitions.explanation: Tools, weapons, and vessels made of iron. Used both in archaeology (the iron implements of ancient cultures) and for traditional crafts such as Nanbu ironware kettles.

examples.japanese: {鉄器|てっき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出土|しゅつど}→出土：11760_shutsudo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
{南部鉄器|なんぶてっき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{急須|きゅうす}→急須：04980_kyuusu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦お{茶|ちゃ}→お茶：00576_ocha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れた→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: I made tea in a Nanbu ironware teapot.

examples.japanese: ⟦{弥生|やよい}{時代|じだい}→弥生時代：20426_yayoijidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{大陸|たいりく}→大陸：03400_tairiku⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{稲作|いなさく}→稲作：09494_inasaku⟧⟦とともに→とともに：30485_totomoni⟧{鉄器|てっき}や{青銅器|せいどうき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{伝|つた}わった→伝わる：01961_tsutawaru⟧。
examples.english: In the Yayoi period, iron and bronze implements came from the continent along with rice farming.

notes:
⟦{鉄|てつ}→鉄：02225_tetsu⟧ (iron) + {器|き} (vessel, implement).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鉄器|てっき}⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧: the Iron Age
- {南部鉄器|なんぶてっき}: Nanbu ironware (traditional cast iron from Iwate)
- {鉄器|てっき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧: cast-iron pot

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {青銅器|せいどうき}: bronze ware — the Bronze Age counterpart
- ⟦{石器|せっき}→石器：19665_sekki⟧: stone tools — the Stone Age counterpart
- ⟦{土器|どき}→土器：09658_doki⟧: earthenware, unglazed pottery
